messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Can I get a discount coupon if I buy these goods?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Of course You get a coupon for every 3 bags of sugar.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: But how much discount can I get if I use it to buy goods next time?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: 10 pence off if you use this coupon.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Can I buy everything in the supermarket by it? .
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Yeah, you need to take advantage of it within its expiry date.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: How long can I keep it?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: The coupon can be used at least one year.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: I see. I will take 9 bags of sugar so that I can get 3 coupons.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: All right. I will get them for you.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Tina, how long have you been learning the piano?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: For 8 years. I began to play when I was 7. My father found a teacher for me who is from the UK.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Ah, are you still learning it from that teacher?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Yes, I go to her home every Saturday.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: No wonder you can play so well.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Yes, my teacher is very excellent and she has won many awards.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Good. Could you please introduce me to her? I also want to learn from her.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Sure. Come with me this Saturday.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Thank you very much.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Hi, Walter!
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Hi, Sterling!
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: What do you think of our new teacher?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Professor Wood? I think he's a brilliant scientist.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: You're got a point there. But do you think he's a little absent-minded?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: I guess so.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: You're all set now?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Oh, thank you so much.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Really, it was nothing.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: I really appreciated it.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: I was happy to help.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: It was so kind of you.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Don't mention it.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: You're a real friend in need.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Listen to this. Mary got married.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Is she really? I can't believe it!
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Yes. Yesterday.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Good gracious. That's incredible!
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: She married Jerrod.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: You're kidding.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: She's going to live in Paris.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Really? I'm surprised.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: I can't believe I still have this pain in my back. This medicine the doctor gave me was supposed to make me feel better by now.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Maybe you should start taking it three times a day like you were told.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: What does your sister look like, Mike?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Well, she's tall and pretty.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Is she like you?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: I suppose so. We're both friendly and easy-going.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Is she as clever as you?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: No, she's not as clever as me.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Big head!
